challengeFindings.title: A diagnose agent reports FAIL because its recommended fix leaves an unhandled break in a dependent surface such as middleware or routing, or flags a `security` rot signal, the remediate agent applies the fix, the gate goes green on suites that never exercise that surface, and the summary drops the FAIL to PASS and the build opens the PR

challengeFindings.title: A debug run on `dev` whose diagnose step reported FAIL for an unhandled break in a dependent surface such as middleware or routing applies the fix anyway, passes the gate on suites that never exercise that surface, gets the summary verdict CONCERNS, and the Step 11 close pushes the fix straight to the shared `dev` branch with no PR and no human, where before the diff the FAIL sent the run to the Failure Path and the fix commits stayed local
